PresenceFact.description: ADR013 (D146). present or absent: at least one source of this product supports the fact. unknown: no supporting evidence, and no sources. Unknown differs from an observed absence; a missing category tag or an incomplete ingredient list never proves absence.

ProductSnapshot.description: LOCAL ONLY. ADR013 (D146): category and scoringFacts are optional; omission means unknown, never general or absent. categorySourceIds must be empty unless the category is known. Cheese and red meat are general-route facts and plain water is a beverage-route fact, so a stated category of another route contradicts them. Snapshots saved before local contract 0.3.0-draft have no scoringFacts and still load: their facts are unknown. Source and citation existence are validated by domain code.

score.description: Union of route bounds: general and fats/nuts/seeds -17..55, beverage -18..54. Domain validation checks the route-specific bound.

ScientificAssessment.description: LOCAL ONLY. Graded example demonstrates shape, not valid method arithmetic. Zero hash is fictional fixture metadata, never an artifact checksum.

templateId.description: Id of a reviewed reason template in the evidence edition. The phone renders the shown sentence from its own copy of that template; it never displays server text directly.

categorySourceIds.description: Sources supporting the product category. Empty when the category is unknown or not stated.

ScoringFacts.description: ADR013 (D146). Source-backed facts that select Nutri-Score route exceptions. Omit the whole object when nothing is known: omission means every fact is unknown and category provenance is unavailable, never absent or general. A partial object is invalid. Each id appears once per list and must name a sourceRef of the same product (domain validation). Plain water excludes a present cheese, red-meat or sweetener fact. Examples are fictional shape checks, not product data.
